checks.basis: Smoke script now checks concrete downstream files instead of deriving success from role self-report alone.

Every role output named in role evidence has a concrete canonical artifact consumed by downstream gates.
Review and verify artifacts are read-only quality evidence; delivery-owned artifacts are written only in phase workspace.
